systems.system: Education in Emergencies Management Information System (EiE-MIS)
systems.owner: Ministry of General Education and Instruction (MoGEI), with technical support from UNESCO and the HISP network, funded by Education Cannot Wait
systems.tiers: Launched at the ministry by August 2026; 35 master trainers are to support rollout across states, counties and schools

note: No fact: the EiE-MIS is described only as a platform to collect, manage and analyse education data during emergencies, with no statement of a record per learner or of what schools enter and when, so its class is left empty. DHIS2 is said to be able to support routine school data collection, as a capability and not as a use. The TVET-MIS it also names is vocational and outside the study. 12 County Education Departments were given solar power, computers and internet (enabling).
